detailedNarrative: CASE001 (FIR/KOTWALIAMR/2025/0001) — Cyber Fraud (Online Investment Scam) registered at PS Kotwali Amritsar, Amritsar. Incident recorded on 2025-01-22 12:53 at Ranjit Avenue Residential, Amritsar. FIR records 1 accused (Imran Khanna P00415) and 5 named persons in total. 1014 records across 5 sources; 19 transactions flagged for review. Money-flow records show funds received and forwarded within minutes (e.g. EVD-TXN000319 → EVD-TXN000320, 9.0 min), a pattern that can indicate layering and requires verification. Account ICIC-36915855749 received funds from 3 different individuals within 14 days. Communication between P00113 and P00415 spiked to 4 contacts within 3 hours on 2025-01-22. Note: P00007 has a record 410.9 km from the incident location 24 min after the incident (EVD-MSG000325), which may be exculpatory and needs verification.
